name: onboarding
summary: Get a designer or an engineer productive on this system, on the path their job actually needs.

when: someone new has to work with the system
the same beginner mistakes keep recurring

steps: Split the paths. A designer needs the token tiers, the composition rules and where the library lives; an engineer needs the gates, the state contract and how to run things locally. One combined document serves neither.
Start with the ONE rule that prevents the most damage — here, that everything renders from one token source and a page that looks different bypassed it.
Have them run the gates on day one. Someone who has watched a gate fail understands the system better than someone who has read about it.
Point at the real examples in this repo, not at invented ones.
Name the beginner mistakes explicitly. They will otherwise be made, found in review, and made again by the next person.
output: A path per role, ending in a first task with a gate on it.
done: the first task ends in a gate that was actually run
